properties.putsql-sql-statement:
INSERT INTO conversions (
  native_product_id,
  converter,
  converter_version, 
  start_time,
  end_time,
  duration,
  flowfile_uuid,success,
  input_product,
  eosip_product_id
)
VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM native_products WHERE name = '${originalNativeProduct.name}' LIMIT 1),
  '${conversion.converter}',
  '${conversion.converterVersion}',
  '${conversion.startTime}',
  '${conversion.endTime}',
  '${conversion.duration}',
  '${uuid}',
  'false',
  '${nativeProduct:substringAfterLast("/")}',
  NULL
);

INSERT INTO archivals_eosip (
  eosip_product_id,
  completed,
  final_destination,
  sha256
)
VALUES (
  (
    SELECT ep.id
    FROM eosip_products ep
    JOIN conversions c ON ep.conversion_id = c.id
    WHERE c.flowfile_uuid = '${uuid}'
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  '${eosipProduct.repatriationTimestamp}',
  '${eosipProduct.repatriationPath}',
  '${eosipProduct.sha256sum}'
);
